setting: You three are market stall holders in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and you all trade in the same market, so you have known each other for years from working side by side.
openers: Send a photo of today's vegetable prices
Share a joke about the morning rush
Check whether anyone is coming to the market early

Rima.knows: You know Arif as the mobile accessories seller a few stalls down, and Kamal as the cloth seller who has been at the market longer than anyone.
Rima.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something about the market comes up.
Rima.style: Some emoji and a few texting abbreviations.

Arif.knows: You know Rima as the vegetable vendor whose stall sits near yours, and Kamal as the older cloth seller you often chat with between customers.
Arif.texts: You message in this chat now and then, usually when a customer or supplier issue needs sharing.
Arif.style: Moderate emoji use and some texting abbreviations.

Kamal.knows: You know Rima as the vegetable seller who has been at the market almost as long as you have, and Arif as the young accessories seller who keeps your cloth stall company in the afternoons.
Kamal.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly to share something you have seen at the market.
Kamal.style: Little emoji use and almost no texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Rima: You run a vegetable stall in the market, and your days start before dawn buying produce and end when the stall closes in the afternoon. You live in a flat in Dhaka with your husband and two children, and you handle the household after the stall closes.
private_lines.Arif: You sell mobile phone accessories at your stall in the market, and your days go from the shop floor to restocking from wholesalers across town. You live in a rented flat in Dhaka with your parents and younger brother, and you spend evenings at home or with friends nearby.
private_lines.Kamal: You sell cloth at your stall in the market, and your days involve arranging bolts, greeting regular buyers, and watching the stall through the busy hours. You live in an older family home in Dhaka with your wife and your married son's family, and you usually take a quiet walk in the evenings.

text: Anyone have spare crates? Need about 10, my supplier short today 🙏
How many sizes? I have some big blue ones behind my stall
Big blue is perfect. How many can u spare
Maybe 6. Rest I need for tomorrow's phone boxes lol
I have four old wooden ones. Not good for vegetables maybe, they are heavy
Wood is ok for onions. Bring if u can
I will ask my son to carry them in the morning
Send me pickup time, I can bring 6 tomorrow before 7
7 is fine 😊
Very small crowd at the cloth stalls today. Wedding season finished early this year.
Slow here too. Sold out cabbage by 2 tho
Good for u. My cable sales dead
Arif did u get the crates to ur place or still at stall
Still at stall, will leave them by the gate. Lock on the gate broke so chain on it
Ok 👍
Sure
7am then. I'll be at the gate before the vans
Up. Going to karwan bazar, then straight to the gate
Leaving now. Mirpur road already jammed 😩
Fog so thick at the gate I could not see the road. My son took the wooden crates to your side already, Rima. Left them by the cloth shutters
Gate open. 6 blue ones here. Where u want them
Van side pls. Ill count
Got 10 total. Thx 😊
Chain is back on the gate. Lock still broken lol
😂 ok
Two bolts of green silk gone from the table at half past six. Boy ran off towards the bus stand. Told the police post, they just wrote it down
Thats the 3rd time this month. Need to put a cover on the table front
Cabbage gone again. Potato left 40kg. Anyone buying potato today 😭
Power banks selling fine at least. Customers keep asking if we have the new cable
Customer just told me the onion at karwan went up again. Not sure how much
It went up yesterday too. Reading the board now, 4 taka more
Kids homework done. I'm off soon, got to be up early again
Do u want the blue crates back or keep till friday
Heard at the tea stall that the govt will check the onion traders this week. Heard it, not sure it is true
Keep the crates till fri pls. Sorry missed ur msg last night 😅
Fog again at the gate. Going slow
Ok fri is fine. Mirpur road jammed already
Police came by again at 9. Asked me what the boy wore. I said small, red shirt. That is all I saw
Cant do much with that lol
Cable came in finally. 20 pcs. Customers already gone to the other side
Potato still 30kg. Dropped to 38 taka
U lower it or market lowered it
Me 😩
Onion board at karwan still shows the new price. Saw the man changing it at 3 o clock, same number
[photo: onion price board at karwan]
Is that the new one or old
New. Same as yesterday
Got the box cutters back from the supplier finally. Going home soon
Potato 20kg left. Hotel boy said he will take 15 at half price tomorrow. Better than nothing
Good. Better to sell than carry back
Took my walk to the river. Fog came back over the water
Leaving the blue crates by the gate in the morning then. Chain still on
